newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV EASES VS MARK, DOLLAR AT CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV EASES VS MARK, DOLLAR AT CLOSE.

text.p: The lev eased to 995-997 per mark at the close on Monday from the morning's 994.80-995.50 on a rise in foreign currency demand from large final clients, dealers said.
* Spot dollar was 1,846-1,850 levs against the opening's 1,836-1,839 tracking a weaker mark/dollar on global markets.
* Under an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism, known as a currency board the lev has been pegged at 1,000 per mark as an anchor currency since July 1.
* The central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at a bid of 995 levs and ask of 1,000 levs under the currency board system. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
